parameters.name: SSLPub
parameters.description: The public key of the certificate. The public key must be Base64 encoding and then URL-encoded (encodeURIComponent). The PEM format is supported.

parameters.name: SSLStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the returned domain name list includes only domain names with HTTPS enabled or disabled.
- **true**: HTTPS is enabled.
- **false**: HTTPS is disabled.
